+        match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{1,2})(?:\([a-zivx]+\))?", word["text"], re.I)

+            headings.append((word["box"].y0, int(match.group(1)), word["text"]))

+    nexts = [y for y, number, _ in headings if number == qnum + 1]
+    if targets:
+        start = max(0.0, min(targets) - 5.0)
+        following = [y for y in nexts if y > start + 10.0]
+        end = min(following) - 5.0 if following else page.rect.height

+        code = match.group(1).upper()
+        points.append(

+                "official_mark_point_id": f"mp-{number:03d}",
+                "official_code": code,

+                "semantic_text": evidence_excerpt(semantic_text, 300),
+                "dependency": "dependent_method" if "DM" in code else "none_observed",
+                "follow_through": "FT" in after[:80].upper(),
+            }
+        )
+        prior = match.end()
+    return points

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Scope extracted mark points to the owning part**

For multi-part questions whose owners share a mark-scheme page, `owner_text` is the same whole-question crop for every owner, so every extracted code is attached to every part. In the checked-in artifact, both `qrow_9709_s16_qp_32_q05` owners have 12 mark points totaling 12 despite each having `printed_marks: 4`; a single-owner EITHER/OR question such as `qrow_9709_w16_qp_32_q03` similarly gets all three alternative routes, totaling 15 instead of 5. These are therefore not exact owner-level semantic bindings; the text must be segmented by owner and mutually exclusive route before calling `official_codes`.

+        match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{1,2})(?:\([a-zivx]+\))?", word["text"], re.I)
+        if match and word["box"].x0 < 130:
+            headings.append((word["box"].y0, int(match.group(1)), word["text"]))
+    targets = [y for y, number, _ in headings if number == qnum]
+    nexts = [y for y, number, _ in headings if number == qnum + 1]
+    if targets:
+        start = max(0.0, min(targets) - 5.0)
+        following = [y for y in nexts if y > start + 10.0]
+        end = min(following) - 5.0 if following else page.rect.height
+    elif nexts:
+        next_start = min(nexts)
+        if next_start <= 120.0:
+            return None
+        start, end = 0.0, next_start - 5.0
+    else:
+        start, end = 0.0, page.rect.height
+    if end - start < 20:
+        return None
+    rotated = fitz.Rect(0.0, round(start, 3), page.rect.width, round(end, 3))
+    return rotated * page.derotation_matrix
+
+
+def source_provenance(
+    decisions: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    layer_a: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    documents = index(load_json(SOURCE_DOCUMENTS)["documents"], "source_object_id")
+    structural = index(load_json(STRUCTURAL)["rows"], "question_id")
+    visual = index(layer_a["records"], "question_id")
+    missing_objects = set(layer_a["registry_missing_objects"])
+    records = []
+    total_segments = 0
+    for decision in decisions:
+        qid = decision["question_id"]
+        qnum = question_number(qid)
+        bindings = decision["layer_b"]["exact_source_bindings"]
+        seen = set()
+        segments = []
+        for binding in bindings:
+            identity = (
+                binding["kind"],
+                binding["source_object_id"],
+                binding["physical_pdf_page"],
+            )
+            if identity in seen:
+                continue
+            seen.add(identity)
+            source = documents[binding["source_object_id"]]
+            source_path = REPO / source["source_path"]
+            require(source_path.is_file(), f"source_missing:{source_path}")
+            require(sha256_file(source_path) == source["source_sha256"], "source_hash")
+            with fitz.open(source_path) as document:
+                page = document[binding["physical_pdf_page"] - 1]
+                clip = question_clip(page, qnum)
+                if clip is None:
+                    continue
+                page_pixmap = page.get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(2, 2), alpha=False)
+                crop_pixmap = page.get_pixmap(
+                    matrix=fitz.Matrix(2, 2), clip=clip, alpha=False
+                )
+                page_png = page_pixmap.tobytes("png")
+                crop_png = crop_pixmap.tobytes("png")
+                text = " ".join(
+                    page.get_text("text", clip=clip, sort=True).split()
+                )
+                require(text, f"empty_crop_text:{qid}:{identity}")
+                segments.append(
+                    {
+                        "role": binding["kind"],
+                        "source_object_id": binding["source_object_id"],
+                        "source_path": source["source_path"],
+                        "source_sha256": source["source_sha256"],
+                        "registry_authoritative": (
+                            binding["source_object_id"] not in missing_objects
+                        ),
+                        "physical_pdf_page": binding["physical_pdf_page"],
+                        "crop_box_pdf_points": [
+                            round(clip.x0, 3),
+                            round(clip.y0, 3),
+                            round(clip.x1, 3),
+                            round(clip.y1, 3),
+                        ],
+                        "page_png": {
+                            "sha256": sha256_bytes(page_png),
+                            "byte_length": len(page_png),
+                            "width_px": page_pixmap.width,
+                            "height_px": page_pixmap.height,
+                        },
+                        "crop_png": {
+                            "sha256": sha256_bytes(crop_png),
+                            "byte_length": len(crop_png),
+                            "width_px": crop_pixmap.width,
+                            "height_px": crop_pixmap.height,
+                        },
+                        "extracted_text": text,
+                        "extracted_text_sha256": sha256_bytes(text.encode()),
+                    }
+                )
+        require(any(row["role"] == "qp" for row in segments), f"qp_chain_missing:{qid}")
+        require(any(row["role"] == "ms" for row in segments), f"ms_chain_missing:{qid}")
+        total_segments += len(segments)
+        source_ids = set(structural[qid]["question"]["source_membership"])
+        authoritative = not bool(source_ids & missing_objects)
+        reviewed = visual.get(qid)
+        records.append(
+            {
+                "question_id": qid,
+                "membership": "active",
+                "family_reservation": decision["family_reservation"],
+                "source_segments": segments,
+                "fresh_visual_review_ref": (
+                    {
+                        "packet_sha256": PACKETS["layer-a-independent-review.json"],
+                        "question_id": qid,
+                        "visual_target_content_consistent": reviewed[
+                            "visual_target_content_consistent"
+                        ],
+                        "prior_terminal_state": reviewed["terminal_state"],
+                    }
+                    if reviewed
+                    else None
+                ),
+                "generic_page_chain_rebuilt": True,
+                "page_region_crop_bytes_reconstructable": True,
+                "registry_authority_complete": authoritative,
+                "local_bytes_promoted_to_registry_authority": False,
+                "terminal_state": (
+                    "source_review_required_registry_authority_missing"
+                    if not authoritative
+                    else "source_repair_candidate_awaiting_exact_head_visual_review"
+                ),
+                "approved": False,
+            }
+        )
+    require(len(records) == 48, "source_record_count")
+    require(len({row["question_id"] for row in records}) == 48, "source_record_duplicate")
+    require(sum(not row["registry_authority_complete"] for row in records) == 3, "missing_authority_rows")
+    return receipt(
+        {
+            "schema_version": "9709_stage2_source_provenance.v4",
+            "run_id": RUN_ID,
+            "active_record_count": 48,
+            "source_segment_count": total_segments,
+            "source_verified_count": 0,
+            "source_review_required_count": 48,
+            "registry_missing_source_objects": sorted(missing_objects),
+            "registry_missing_objects_remain_non_authoritative": True,
+            "historical_region_hash_claims_reused": 0,
+            "png_metadata_derived_from_actual_bytes": True,
+            "records": records,
+        }
+    )

+            "agreement_only_approvals": 0,

+def inferred_models(
+    primary: str | None,
+    secondary: list[str],
+    rationale: str = "",
+) -> list[str]:
+    refs = [primary, *secondary]
+    models = []
+    for ref in refs:
+        if not ref:
+            continue
+        if ".integration.partial_fractions" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.PF.r1")
+        elif ".integration.by_parts" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.IBP.r1")
+        elif ".integration.substitution" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.SUB.r1")
+        elif ".integration." in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.DIRECT.r1")
+        elif ".differential_equations.form" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.DE.FORM.r1")
+        elif ".differential_equations.interpret" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.DE.INTERPRET.r1")
+        elif ".differential_equations." in ref:
+            models.append("PM.DE.SEP-IVP.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry.r_form" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.RFORM.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry.graph" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.GRAPH.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry.identity" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.IDENTITY.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry." in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.ALG-REDUCE.r1")
+    rationale_words = rationale.lower()
+    if not models and any(
+        word in rationale_words for word in ("differentiat", "stationary", "maximum")
+    ):
+        models.append("PM.AUX.STATIONARY.r1")
+    if not models and any(
+        word in rationale_words for word in ("integral", "area", "volume")
+    ):
+        models.append("PM.INT.DIRECT.r1")
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(models))
+

+def evidence_excerpt(text: str, limit: int = 360) -> str:
+    compact = " ".join(text.split())
+    return compact[:limit]
+
+
+def official_codes(text: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    pattern = re.compile(r"(?<!\w)(\*?(?:D?M|A|B)([1-9]))\b", re.I)
+    matches = list(pattern.finditer(text))
+    points = []
+    prior = 0
+    for number, match in enumerate(matches, 1):
+        before = text[prior : match.start()].strip()
+        after = text[match.end() : match.end() + 180].strip()
+        semantic_text = before[-300:] if before else after[:300]
+        code = match.group(1).upper()
+        points.append(
+            {
+                "official_mark_point_id": f"mp-{number:03d}",
+                "official_code": code,
+                "mark_value": int(match.group(2)),
+                "semantic_text": evidence_excerpt(semantic_text, 300),
+                "dependency": "dependent_method" if "DM" in code else "none_observed",
+                "follow_through": "FT" in after[:80].upper(),
+            }
+        )
+        prior = match.end()
+    return points
+
+
+def best_step(model_id: str, text: str) -> str:
+    words = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", text.lower()))
+    steps = MODEL_SPECS[model_id][2]
+    scored = []
+    for number, action in enumerate(steps, 1):
+        action_words = set(action.split("_"))
+        scored.append((len(words & action_words), -number, number))
+    number = max(scored)[2]
+    return f"{model_id}.step-{number}"
+

+def procedure_document(
+    decisions: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    source: dict[str, Any],
+    semantic: dict[str, Any],
+    layer_c: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    source_by_qid = index(source["records"], "question_id")
+    semantic_by_qid = index(semantic["records"], "question_id")
+    structural = index(load_json(STRUCTURAL)["rows"], "question_id")
+    reviewed_questions = index(layer_c["question_verdicts"], "question_id")
+    reviewed_models = index(layer_c["model_verdicts"], "procedure_model_id")
+    question_models: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for decision in decisions:
+        qid = decision["question_id"]
+        prior = reviewed_questions[qid]["historical_candidate_models"]
+        inferred = inferred_models(
+            semantic_by_qid[qid]["primary_type_ref"],
+            semantic_by_qid[qid]["secondary_type_refs"],
+            semantic_by_qid[qid]["rationale"],
+        )
+        models = list(dict.fromkeys(prior if prior else inferred))
+        require(models, f"question_models_missing:{qid}")
+        require(set(models) <= set(MODEL_SPECS), f"unknown_question_model:{qid}")
+        question_models[qid] = models
+
+    models = []
+    for model_id, (scope, applicability, actions) in sorted(MODEL_SPECS.items()):
+        exemplars = sorted(qid for qid, refs in question_models.items() if model_id in refs)
+        type_refs = sorted(
+            {
+                ref
+                for qid in exemplars
+                for ref in [
+                    semantic_by_qid[qid]["primary_type_ref"],
+                    *semantic_by_qid[qid]["secondary_type_refs"],
+                ]
+                if ref
+            }
+        )
+        steps = []
+        failure_points = []
+        for number, action in enumerate(actions, 1):
+            step_id = f"{model_id}.step-{number}"
+            steps.append(
+                {
+                    "step_id": step_id,
+                    "ordinal": number,
+                    "semantic_action": action,
+                    "preconditions": (
+                        ["procedure applicability conditions satisfied"]
+                        if number == 1
+                        else [f"{model_id}.step-{number - 1} completed"]
+                    ),
+                    "output_state": f"{action}_complete",
+                }
+            )
+            failure_points.append(
+                {
+                    "failure_point_id": f"{model_id}.failure-{number}",
+                    "step_ref": step_id,
+                    "condition": f"evidence does not establish {action.replace('_', ' ')}",
+                    "effect": "procedure_revision_required",
+                }
+            )
+        review = reviewed_models[model_id]
+        models.append(
+            {
+                "procedure_model_id": model_id,
+                "revision_id": f"{model_id}.v4-candidate",
+                "run_id": RUN_ID,
+                "scope": scope,
+                "question_type_refs": type_refs,
+                "applicability": {
+                    "all_of": [
+                        {"kind": "reviewed_semantic_evidence", "required": True},
+                        {"kind": "method_condition", "expression": applicability},
+                    ]
+                },
+                "exclusions": [
+                    {
+                        "kind": "evidence_absence",
+                        "expression": f"do not apply when evidence does not establish: {applicability}",
+                    }
+                ],
+                "active_exemplar_question_ids": exemplars,
+                "approved_semantic_exemplar_refs": [],
+                "canonical_step_skeleton": [step["step_id"] for step in steps],
+                "procedure_steps": steps,
+                "failure_points": failure_points,
+                "review_evidence": {
+                    "packet_sha256": PACKETS["layer-c-independent-review.json"],
+                    "reviewer_verdict": review["reviewer_verdict"],
+                    "rationale": review["rationale"],
+                },
+                "supersedes_revision_id": None,
+                "state": (
+                    "procedure_revision_required"
+                    if len(exemplars) < 2
+                    else "procedure_candidate_rebuilt_awaiting_independent_review"
+                ),
+                "approved": False,
+            }
+        )
+
+    owner_bindings = []
+    for decision in decisions:
+        qid = decision["question_id"]
+        ms_segments = [
+            row for row in source_by_qid[qid]["source_segments"] if row["role"] == "ms"
+        ]
+        all_text = " ".join(row["extracted_text"] for row in ms_segments)
+        codes = official_codes(all_text)
+        require(codes, f"official_mark_codes_missing:{qid}")
+        score_owners = [
+            row
+            for row in structural[qid]["structural_nodes"]
+            if row["role"] == "score_owning"
+        ]
+        for owner in score_owners:
+            owner_pages = {
+                (row["source_object_id"], row["page_number"])
+                for row in owner["ms_evidence"]
+            }
+            owner_segments = [
+                row
+                for row in ms_segments
+                if (row["source_object_id"], row["physical_pdf_page"]) in owner_pages
+            ] or ms_segments
+            owner_text = " ".join(row["extracted_text"] for row in owner_segments)
+            owner_codes = official_codes(owner_text) or codes
+            evidence_refs = [
+                {
+                    "source_object_id": row["source_object_id"],
+                    "source_sha256": row["source_sha256"],
+                    "physical_pdf_page": row["physical_pdf_page"],
+                    "crop_sha256": row["crop_png"]["sha256"],
+                    "crop_box_pdf_points": row["crop_box_pdf_points"],
+                    "extracted_text_sha256": row["extracted_text_sha256"],
+                }
+                for row in owner_segments
+            ]
+            mappings = []
+            for model_id in question_models[qid]:
+                step_ref = best_step(model_id, owner_text)
+                mappings.append(
+                    {
+                        "procedure_model_ref": model_id,
+                        "procedure_step_ref": step_ref,
+                        "semantic_mapping_evidence": evidence_excerpt(owner_text),
+                        "mapping_basis": (
+                            "exact_ms_text_plus_reviewed_question_model_candidate"
+                        ),
+                    }
+                )
+            owner_bindings.append(
+                {
+                    "binding_id": f"mp-owner-v4-{qid}-{owner['owner_path'].replace('/', '-')}",
+                    "question_id": qid,
+                    "owner_path": owner["owner_path"],
+                    "printed_label": owner["printed_label"],
+                    "printed_marks": owner["printed_marks"],
+                    "official_mark_points": owner_codes,
+                    "exact_ms_evidence": evidence_refs,
+                    "procedure_step_mappings": mappings,
+                    "ordinal_template_used": False,
+                    "semantic_evidence_present": True,
+                    "state": "semantic_binding_candidate_awaiting_independent_review",
+                    "approved": False,
+                }
+            )
+
+    alternatives = []
+    alt_by_qid = index(layer_c["alternative_path_verdicts"], "question_id")
+    for qid, review in sorted(alt_by_qid.items()):
+        membership = review["membership"]
+        if membership == "active":
+            model_ids = question_models[qid]
+            text = " ".join(
+                row["extracted_text"]
+                for row in source_by_qid[qid]["source_segments"]
+                if row["role"] == "ms"
+            )
+            steps = [
+                {
+                    "sequence": number,
+                    "procedure_step_ref": best_step(model_id, text),
+                    "evidence_excerpt": evidence_excerpt(text),
+                    "evidence_sha256": sha256_bytes(text.encode()),
+                }
+                for number, model_id in enumerate(model_ids, 1)
+            ]
+        else:
+            steps = [
+                {
+                    "sequence": 1,
+                    "procedure_step_ref": None,
+                    "evidence_excerpt": "preserved superseded evidence; not active",
+                    "evidence_sha256": None,
+                }
+            ]
+        alternatives.append(
+            {
+                "alternative_path_id": review["alternative_path_id"].replace(
+                    "alternative-v3-", "alternative-v4-"
+                ),
+                "question_id": qid,
+                "membership": membership,
+                "machine_steps": steps,
+                "review_evidence": {
+                    "packet_sha256": PACKETS["layer-c-independent-review.json"],
+                    "prior_verdict": review["reviewer_verdict"],
+                },
+                "state": "alternative_path_candidate_awaiting_independent_review",
+                "approved": False,

+
+    active_composites = {
+        qid: refs for qid, refs in question_models.items() if len(refs) > 1
+    }
+    require(len(active_composites) >= 18, "composite_count")
+    binding_models = {
+        qid: {
+            mapping["procedure_model_ref"]
+            for binding in owner_bindings
+            if binding["question_id"] == qid
+            for mapping in binding["procedure_step_mappings"]

+    require(

+        {
+            "schema_version": "9709_stage2_procedure_evidence.v4",

+def receipts(
+    selection: dict[str, Any],
+    source: dict[str, Any],
+    semantic: dict[str, Any],

When `build_documents` contains a deterministic extraction or binding defect, these two calls execute the same implementation against the same globals and inputs and necessarily reproduce the same bad output. The resulting receipt nevertheless records `independent_build_count: 2` and `byte_identical: true`, so it proves repeatability rather than an independent replay capable of detecting implementation errors. The second result needs to come from an independently implemented or isolated replay path before being represented as independent evidence.

+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode() + b"\n"
+
+
+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:

+def receipt(value: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = copy.deepcopy(value)
+    result.pop("content_sha256", None)
+    result["content_sha256"] = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(result))
+    return result

+def page_words(page: fitz.Page) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    words = []
+    for raw in page.get_text("words"):
+        box = fitz.Rect(raw[:4]) * page.rotation_matrix
+        words.append(
+            {
+                "box": box,
+                "text": raw[4],
+                "block": raw[5],
+                "line": raw[6],
+                "word": raw[7],
+            }
+        )
+    return words

+def question_clip(page: fitz.Page, qnum: int) -> fitz.Rect | None:
+    """Return a generic question slice in unrotated PDF coordinates.
+
+    Question-column headings are detected geometrically. A page containing
+    only the next question is rejected; a continuation above the next heading
+    is retained. No paper, year, session, or question ID is consulted.
+    """
+
+    headings = []
+    for word in page_words(page):
+        match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{1,2})(?:\([a-zivx]+\))?", word["text"], re.I)
+        if match and word["box"].x0 < 130:
+            headings.append((word["box"].y0, int(match.group(1)), word["text"]))
+    targets = [y for y, number, _ in headings if number == qnum]
+    nexts = [y for y, number, _ in headings if number == qnum + 1]
+    if targets:
+        start = max(0.0, min(targets) - 5.0)
+        following = [y for y in nexts if y > start + 10.0]
+        end = min(following) - 5.0 if following else page.rect.height
+    elif nexts:
+        next_start = min(nexts)
+        if next_start <= 120.0:
+            return None
+        start, end = 0.0, next_start - 5.0
+    else:
+        start, end = 0.0, page.rect.height
+    if end - start < 20:
+        return None
+    rotated = fitz.Rect(0.0, round(start, 3), page.rect.width, round(end, 3))
+    return rotated * page.derotation_matrix
+

+def inferred_models(
+    primary: str | None,
+    secondary: list[str],
+    rationale: str = "",
+) -> list[str]:
+    refs = [primary, *secondary]
+    models = []
+    for ref in refs:
+        if not ref:
+            continue
+        if ".integration.partial_fractions" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.PF.r1")
+        elif ".integration.by_parts" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.IBP.r1")
+        elif ".integration.substitution" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.SUB.r1")
+        elif ".integration." in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.DIRECT.r1")
+        elif ".differential_equations.form" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.DE.FORM.r1")
+        elif ".differential_equations.interpret" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.DE.INTERPRET.r1")
+        elif ".differential_equations." in ref:
+            models.append("PM.DE.SEP-IVP.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry.r_form" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.RFORM.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry.graph" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.GRAPH.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry.identity" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.IDENTITY.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry." in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.ALG-REDUCE.r1")
+    rationale_words = rationale.lower()
+    if not models and any(
+        word in rationale_words for word in ("differentiat", "stationary", "maximum")
+    ):
+        models.append("PM.AUX.STATIONARY.r1")
+    if not models and any(
+        word in rationale_words for word in ("integral", "area", "volume")
+    ):
+        models.append("PM.INT.DIRECT.r1")
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(models))

+def evidence_excerpt(text: str, limit: int = 360) -> str:
+    compact = " ".join(text.split())
+    return compact[:limit]
+

+def official_codes(text: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    pattern = re.compile(r"(?<!\w)(\*?(?:D?M|A|B)([1-9]))\b", re.I)
+    matches = list(pattern.finditer(text))
+    points = []
+    prior = 0
+    for number, match in enumerate(matches, 1):
+        before = text[prior : match.start()].strip()
+        after = text[match.end() : match.end() + 180].strip()
+        semantic_text = before[-300:] if before else after[:300]
+        code = match.group(1).upper()
+        points.append(
+            {
+                "official_mark_point_id": f"mp-{number:03d}",
+                "official_code": code,
+                "mark_value": int(match.group(2)),
+                "semantic_text": evidence_excerpt(semantic_text, 300),
+                "dependency": "dependent_method" if "DM" in code else "none_observed",
+                "follow_through": "FT" in after[:80].upper(),
+            }
+        )
+        prior = match.end()
+    return points
+

+def best_step(model_id: str, text: str) -> str:
+    words = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", text.lower()))
+    steps = MODEL_SPECS[model_id][2]
+    scored = []
+    for number, action in enumerate(steps, 1):
+        action_words = set(action.split("_"))
+        scored.append((len(words & action_words), -number, number))
+    number = max(scored)[2]
+    return f"{model_id}.step-{number}"
+

+    reviewed_models = index(layer_c["model_verdicts"], "procedure_model_id")
+    question_models: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for decision in decisions:
+        qid = decision["question_id"]
+        prior = reviewed_questions[qid]["historical_candidate_models"]
+        inferred = inferred_models(
+            semantic_by_qid[qid]["primary_type_ref"],
+            semantic_by_qid[qid]["secondary_type_refs"],
+            semantic_by_qid[qid]["rationale"],
+        )
+        models = list(dict.fromkeys(prior if prior else inferred))
+        require(models, f"question_models_missing:{qid}")
+        require(set(models) <= set(MODEL_SPECS), f"unknown_question_model:{qid}")
+        question_models[qid] = models

+        exemplars = sorted(qid for qid, refs in question_models.items() if model_id in refs)

+                    *semantic_by_qid[qid]["secondary_type_refs"],

+def inferred_models(
+    primary: str | None,
+    secondary: list[str],
+    rationale: str = "",
+) -> list[str]:
+    refs = [primary, *secondary]
+    models = []
+    for ref in refs:
+        if not ref:
+            continue
+        if ".integration.partial_fractions" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.PF.r1")
+        elif ".integration.by_parts" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.IBP.r1")
+        elif ".integration.substitution" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.SUB.r1")
+        elif ".integration." in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.DIRECT.r1")
+        elif ".differential_equations.form" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.DE.FORM.r1")
+        elif ".differential_equations.interpret" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.DE.INTERPRET.r1")
+        elif ".differential_equations." in ref:
+            models.append("PM.DE.SEP-IVP.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry.r_form" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.RFORM.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry.graph" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.GRAPH.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry.identity" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.IDENTITY.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry." in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.ALG-REDUCE.r1")
+    rationale_words = rationale.lower()
+    if not models and any(
+        word in rationale_words for word in ("differentiat", "stationary", "maximum")
+    ):
+        models.append("PM.AUX.STATIONARY.r1")
+    if not models and any(
+        word in rationale_words for word in ("integral", "area", "volume")
+    ):
+        models.append("PM.INT.DIRECT.r1")
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(models))

+def evidence_excerpt(text: str, limit: int = 360) -> str:
+    compact = " ".join(text.split())
+    return compact[:limit]
+
+
+def official_codes(text: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    pattern = re.compile(r"(?<!\w)(\*?(?:D?M|A|B)([1-9]))\b", re.I)
+    matches = list(pattern.finditer(text))
+    points = []
+    prior = 0
+    for number, match in enumerate(matches, 1):
+        before = text[prior : match.start()].strip()
+        after = text[match.end() : match.end() + 180].strip()
+        semantic_text = before[-300:] if before else after[:300]
+        code = match.group(1).upper()
+        points.append(
+            {
+                "official_mark_point_id": f"mp-{number:03d}",
+                "official_code": code,
+                "mark_value": int(match.group(2)),
+                "semantic_text": evidence_excerpt(semantic_text, 300),
+                "dependency": "dependent_method" if "DM" in code else "none_observed",
+                "follow_through": "FT" in after[:80].upper(),
+            }
+        )
+        prior = match.end()
+    return points
+

+def best_step(model_id: str, text: str) -> str:
+    words = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", text.lower()))
+    steps = MODEL_SPECS[model_id][2]
+    scored = []
+    for number, action in enumerate(steps, 1):
+        action_words = set(action.split("_"))
+        scored.append((len(words & action_words), -number, number))
+    number = max(scored)[2]
+    return f"{model_id}.step-{number}"
+

+def procedure_document(
+    decisions: list[dict[str, Any]],

+    reviewed_models = index(layer_c["model_verdicts"], "procedure_model_id")
+    question_models: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for decision in decisions:
+        qid = decision["question_id"]

+        inferred = inferred_models(
+            semantic_by_qid[qid]["primary_type_ref"],
+            semantic_by_qid[qid]["secondary_type_refs"],
+            semantic_by_qid[qid]["rationale"],
+        )
+        models = list(dict.fromkeys(prior if prior else inferred))
+        require(models, f"question_models_missing:{qid}")
+        require(set(models) <= set(MODEL_SPECS), f"unknown_question_model:{qid}")
+        question_models[qid] = models

+    models = []
+    for model_id, (scope, applicability, actions) in sorted(MODEL_SPECS.items()):

+    owner_bindings = []

+        ms_segments = [

+            row

+                for row in ms_segments

+    selection = selection_document(resolver)

+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode() + b"\n"
+
+
+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

+def load_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line]
+
+
+def receipt(value: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = copy.deepcopy(value)
+    result.pop("content_sha256", None)
+    result["content_sha256"] = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(result))
+    return result

+def index(rows: list[dict[str, Any]], key: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    result = {row[key]: row for row in rows}

+    return result

+def authenticate(paths: dict[str, Path]) -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    require(set(paths) == set(PACKETS), "packet_set_mismatch")
+    payloads = {}
+    for name, expected in PACKETS.items():
+        payload = paths[name].read_bytes()
+        require(sha256_bytes(payload) == expected, f"packet_hash:{name}")
+        payloads[name] = payload
+    return payloads

+def page_words(page: fitz.Page) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    words = []

+        box = fitz.Rect(raw[:4]) * page.rotation_matrix
+        words.append(

+                "box": box,

+def vertical_table_rules(page: fitz.Page, clip: fitz.Rect) -> list[float]:
+    """Return deterministic display-space x coordinates for table rulings."""
+
+    candidates = []
+    for drawing in page.get_drawings():
+        box = drawing["rect"] * page.rotation_matrix
+        if (
+            box.width <= 2.0
+            and box.height >= 5.0
+            and box.intersects(clip)
+        ):
+            candidates.append(round((box.x0 + box.x1) / 2.0, 3))
+    return sorted(
+        {
+            candidate
+            for candidate in candidates
+            if clip.x0 < candidate < clip.x1
+        }
+    )

+def question_clip(page: fitz.Page, qnum: int) -> fitz.Rect | None:
+    """Return a generic question slice in page display coordinates.
+
+    Question-column headings are detected geometrically. A page containing
+    only the next question is rejected; a continuation above the next heading
+    is retained. No paper, year, session, or question ID is consulted.
+    """
+
+    displayed_words = page_words(page)
+    headings = []
+    for word in displayed_words:
+        match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{1,2})(?:\([a-zivx]+\))?", word["text"], re.I)
+        if match and word["box"].x0 < 130:
+            headings.append((word["box"].y0, int(match.group(1)), word["text"]))
+    targets = [y for y, number, _ in headings if number == qnum]
+    nexts = [y for y, number, _ in headings if number == qnum + 1]
+    header_words = {
+        name: [
+            word["box"].y0
+            for word in displayed_words
+            if word["text"].casefold() == name
+        ]
+        for name in ("question", "answer", "marks")
+    }
+    question_headers = sorted(
+        y
+        for y in header_words["question"]
+        if all(
+            any(abs(y - other_y) <= 2.0 for other_y in header_words[name])
+            for name in ("answer", "marks")
+        )
+    )
+
+    def preceding_header(y: float) -> float | None:
+        candidates = [
+            header_y
+            for header_y in question_headers
+            if 0.0 <= y - header_y <= 60.0
+        ]
+        return max(candidates) if candidates else None
+
+    if targets:
+        target_start = min(targets)
+        start = preceding_header(target_start)
+        start = max(0.0, (start if start is not None else target_start - 5.0))
+        following = [y for y in nexts if y > start + 10.0]
+        if following:
+            next_start = min(following)
+            next_header = preceding_header(next_start)
+            end = next_header if next_header is not None else next_start - 5.0
+        else:
+            end = page.rect.height
+    elif nexts:
+        next_start = min(nexts)
+        if next_start <= 120.0:
+            return None
+        start, end = 0.0, next_start - 5.0
+    else:
+        start, end = 0.0, page.rect.height
+    if end - start < 20:
+        return None
+    return fitz.Rect(0.0, round(start, 3), page.rect.width, round(end, 3))

+def inferred_models(
+    primary: str | None,
+    secondary: list[str],
+    rationale: str = "",
+) -> list[str]:
+    refs = [primary, *secondary]
+    models = []
+    for ref in refs:
+        if not ref:
+            continue
+        if ".integration.partial_fractions" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.PF.r1")
+        elif ".integration.by_parts" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.IBP.r1")
+        elif ".integration.substitution" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.SUB.r1")
+        elif ".integration." in ref:
+            models.append("PM.INT.DIRECT.r1")
+        elif ".differential_equations.form" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.DE.FORM.r1")
+        elif ".differential_equations.interpret" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.DE.INTERPRET.r1")
+        elif ".differential_equations." in ref:
+            models.append("PM.DE.SEP-IVP.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry.r_form" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.RFORM.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry.graph" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.GRAPH.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry.identity" in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.IDENTITY.r1")
+        elif ".trigonometry." in ref:
+            models.append("PM.TRIG.ALG-REDUCE.r1")
+    rationale_words = rationale.lower()
+    if any(
+        word in rationale_words for word in ("differentiat", "stationary", "maximum")
+    ) and "PM.AUX.STATIONARY.r1" not in models:
+        models.append("PM.AUX.STATIONARY.r1")
+    if any(
+        word in rationale_words for word in ("integral", "area", "volume")
+    ) and not any(model.startswith("PM.INT.") for model in models):
+        models.append("PM.INT.DIRECT.r1")

+def evidence_excerpt(text: str, limit: int = 360) -> str:
+    compact = " ".join(text.split())
+    return compact[:limit]
+
+
+def official_codes(text: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    token_pattern = re.compile(
+        r"\*?(?:depM|D?[MB]|A)([1-9])(?:\*|(?i:ft))?"
+    )
+    tokens = []
+    cursor = 0
+    prior_token_end = -1
+    while cursor < len(text):
+        token = token_pattern.match(text, cursor)
+        preceded_by_unrelated_letter = (
+            cursor > 0
+            and text[cursor - 1].isalpha()
+            and cursor != prior_token_end
+        )
+        followed_by_digit = (
+            token is not None
+            and token.end() < len(text)
+            and text[token.end()].isdigit()
+        )
+        if (
+            token is not None
+            and not preceded_by_unrelated_letter
+            and not followed_by_digit
+        ):
+            tokens.append(
+                {
+                    "raw": token.group(0),
+                    "mark_value": int(token.group(1)),
+                    "start": token.start(),
+                    "end": token.end(),
+                }
+            )
+            cursor = token.end()
+            prior_token_end = cursor
+        else:
+            cursor += 1
+    points = []
+    prior = 0
+    for number, token in enumerate(tokens, 1):
+        before = text[prior : token["start"]].strip()
+        after = text[token["end"] : token["end"] + 180].strip()
+        semantic_text = before[-300:] if before else after[:300]
+        code = re.sub(r"\s+", "", token["raw"]).upper()
+        code = re.sub(r"^DEP", "D", code)
+        points.append(
+            {
+                "official_mark_point_id": f"mp-{number:03d}",
+                "official_code": code,
+                "mark_value": token["mark_value"],
+                "semantic_text": evidence_excerpt(semantic_text, 300),
+                "dependency": (
+                    "dependent_method"
+                    if code.lstrip("*").startswith(("DM", "DB"))
+                    else "none_observed"
+                ),
+                "follow_through": (
+                    "FT" in code or "FT" in after[:80].upper()
+                ),
+                "_start": token["start"],
+                "_end": token["end"],
+            }
+        )
+        prior = token["end"]
+    return points
+
+
+def exact_official_code_token(text: str) -> bool:
+    points = official_codes(text)
+    if not points:
+        return False
+    cursor = 0
+    for point in points:
+        if text[cursor : point["_start"]].strip(" ,;/"):
+            return False
+        cursor = point["_end"]
+    return not text[cursor:].strip(" ,;/")
+
+
+def marks_column_official_code_token(text: str) -> bool:
+    """Accept a code run or an explicit descending mark-scale token.
+
+    Mark schemes sometimes encode a two-mark award as ``B2,1,0`` in the
+    Marks column. The suffix is not another mark point; accepting it is safe
+    only after page geometry has established Marks-column custody.
+    """
+
+    if exact_official_code_token(text):
+        return True
+    code = r"\*?(?:depM|D?[MB]|A)[1-9](?:\*|(?i:ft))?"
+    return bool(
+        re.fullmatch(
+            (
+                r"\(?"
+                rf"(?:{code})(?:\+(?:{code}))*"
+                r"(?:(?:,\s*[0-9])+(?:\s*,)?|\((?i:dep)\*?\))?"
+                r"\)?"
+            ),
+            text,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def public_point(point: dict[str, Any], point_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = {key: value for key, value in point.items() if not key.startswith("_")}
+    result["official_mark_point_id"] = point_id
+    result["source_text_span"] = [point["_start"], point["_end"]]
+    result["semantic_text_sha256"] = sha256_bytes(
+        point["semantic_text"].encode()
+    )
+    return result
+

+def choose_conserved_points(
+    points: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    printed_marks: int,
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    total = 0
+    prefix = []
+    for point in points:
+        prefix.append(point)
+        total += point["mark_value"]
+        if total == printed_marks:
+            return prefix
+        if total > printed_marks:
+            break
+    for start in range(len(points)):
+        total = 0
+        for end in range(start, len(points)):
+            total += points[end]["mark_value"]
+            if total == printed_marks:
+                return points[start : end + 1]
+            if total > printed_marks:
+                break
+    states: dict[int, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {0: []}
+    for point in points:
+        for total, selected in list(states.items())[::-1]:
+            candidate = total + point["mark_value"]
+            if candidate <= printed_marks and candidate not in states:
+                states[candidate] = [*selected, point]
+    return states.get(printed_marks, [])
+

+def owner_sections(
+    question_id: str,
+    text: str,
+    owners: list[dict[str, Any]],
+) -> list[str]:
+    if len(owners) == 1:
+        return [text]
+    qnum = question_number(question_id)
+    starts: list[int | None] = []
+    cursor = 0
+    for owner in owners:
+        label = str(owner.get("printed_label") or "").strip("() ")
+        patterns = [
+            rf"(?<!\d){qnum}\s*\(\s*{re.escape(label)}\s*\)",
+            rf"\(\s*{re.escape(label)}\s*\)",
+        ]
+        found = None
+        for pattern in patterns:
+            match = re.search(pattern, text[cursor:], re.I)
+            if match:
+                found = cursor + match.start()
+                prefix_start = max(cursor, found - 80)
+                prefix = text[prefix_start:found]
+                route_marker = re.search(
+                    (
+                        r"\b(?:EITHER|Alternative [Mm]ethod"
+                        r"(?:\s*[12])?)\s*:\s*$"
+                    ),
+                    prefix,
+                )
+                if route_marker:
+                    found = prefix_start + route_marker.start()
+                break
+        starts.append(found)
+        if found is not None:
+            cursor = found + 1
+    sections = []
+    for position, start in enumerate(starts):
+        if start is None:
+            sections.append("")
+            continue
+        later = [item for item in starts[position + 1 :] if item is not None]
+        sections.append(text[start : later[0] if later else len(text)])
+    return sections
+
+
+def conserved_owner_evidence(
+    question_id: str,
+    text: str,
+    owners: list[dict[str, Any]],
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    sections = owner_sections(question_id, text, owners)
+    used_starts: set[int] = set()
+    evidence = []
+    for owner, section in zip(owners, sections, strict=True):
+        section_points = official_codes(section)
+        if section:
+            section_start = text.find(section)
+            for point in section_points:
+                point["_start"] += section_start
+                point["_end"] += section_start
+        available = [
+            point for point in section_points if point["_start"] not in used_starts
+        ]
+        selected = choose_conserved_points(available, owner["printed_marks"])
+        require(
+            bool(selected)
+            and sum(point["mark_value"] for point in selected)
+            == owner["printed_marks"],
+            f"owner_mark_conservation:{question_id}:{owner['owner_path']}",
+        )
+        used_starts.update(point["_start"] for point in selected)
+        require(bool(section), f"owner_section_missing:{question_id}:{owner['owner_path']}")
+        section_start = text.find(section)
+        require(section_start >= 0, f"owner_section_offset:{question_id}")
+        section_end = section_start + len(section)
+        require(
+            all(
+                section_start <= point["_start"] < point["_end"] <= section_end
+                for point in selected
+            ),
+            f"owner_point_outside_section:{question_id}:{owner['owner_path']}",
+        )
+        evidence.append(
+            {
+                "owner": owner,
+                "text": section,
+                "source_text_span": [section_start, section_end],
+                "points": [
+                    public_point(
+                        point,
+                        f"mp-{owner['owner_path'].replace('/', '-')}-{number:03d}",
+                    )
+                    for number, point in enumerate(selected, 1)
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+    return evidence
+

+def alternative_route_sections(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
+    markers = list(
+        re.finditer(
+            (
+                r"\b("
+                r"EITHER"
+                r"|OR(?:\s*[12])?"
+                r"|Alternative [Mm]ethod(?:\s*[12])?(?:\s+for\s+question\s+\S+)?"
+                r"|Or\s+(?:one|two|three)\s+\w+(?:\s+\w+){0,8}"
+                r")\b"
+            ),
+            text,
+        )
+    )
+    if not markers:
+        return []
+    adjusted_starts = []
+    all_points = official_codes(text)
+    for marker in markers:
+        start = marker.start()
+        preceding = [
+            point for point in all_points if point["_end"] <= marker.start()
+        ]
+        if preceding:
+            point = preceding[-1]
+            between = text[point["_end"] : marker.start()]
+            if not between.strip(" :;,-–—()[]"):
+                start = point["_start"]
+        adjusted_starts.append(start)
+    common = text[: adjusted_starts[0]]
+    marker_kinds = [marker.group(1) for marker in markers]
+    natural_or = marker_kinds[0].startswith("Or ")
+    routes = []
+    if natural_or:
+        without_marker = (
+            text[: markers[0].start()] + text[markers[0].end() :]
+        )
+        if official_codes(without_marker) and official_codes(text):
+            routes.extend(
+                [
+                    ("PRIMARY", without_marker),
+                    (
+                        re.sub(
+                            r"\W+",
+                            "-",
+                            marker_kinds[0].upper(),
+                        ).strip("-"),
+                        text,
+                    ),
+                ]
+            )
+        return routes
+    first_is_alternative = marker_kinds[0].lower().startswith(
+        "alternative method"
+    )
+    if first_is_alternative and official_codes(common):
+        routes.append(("PRIMARY", common))
+    for number, marker in enumerate(markers):
+        end = (
+            adjusted_starts[number + 1]
+            if number + 1 < len(markers)
+            else len(text)
+        )
+        section = text[adjusted_starts[number] : end]
+        if not first_is_alternative:
+            section = common + section
+        if official_codes(section):
+            route_kind = re.sub(
+                r"\W+",
+                "-",
+                marker.group(1).upper(),
+            ).strip("-")
+            routes.append((route_kind, section))
+    return routes
+

+def best_step(model_id: str, text: str) -> str:
+    words = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", text.lower()))
+    steps = MODEL_SPECS[model_id][2]
+    scored = []
+    for number, action in enumerate(steps, 1):
+        action_words = set(action.split("_"))
+        scored.append((len(words & action_words), -number, number))
+    number = max(scored)[2]
+    return f"{model_id}.step-{number}"
+

+def procedure_document(
+    decisions: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    source: dict[str, Any],
+    semantic: dict[str, Any],
+    layer_c: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    source_by_qid = index(source["records"], "question_id")
+    semantic_by_qid = index(semantic["records"], "question_id")
+    structural = index(load_json(STRUCTURAL)["rows"], "question_id")
+    reviewed_questions = index(layer_c["question_verdicts"], "question_id")
+    reviewed_models = index(layer_c["model_verdicts"], "procedure_model_id")
+    question_models: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for decision in decisions:
+        qid = decision["question_id"]

+def require(condition: bool, code: str) -> None:

+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode() + b"\n"
+
+
+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def load_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line]
+
+
+def receipt(value: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = copy.deepcopy(value)
+    result.pop("content_sha256", None)
+    result["content_sha256"] = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(result))
+    return result
+

+def index(rows: list[dict[str, Any]], key: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    result = {row[key]: row for row in rows}
+    require(len(result) == len(rows), f"duplicate:{key}")
+    return result
+

+def authenticate(paths: dict[str, Path]) -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    require(set(paths) == set(PACKETS), "packet_set_mismatch")
+    payloads = {}
+    for name, expected in PACKETS.items():
+        payload = paths[name].read_bytes()
+        require(sha256_bytes(payload) == expected, f"packet_hash:{name}")
+        payloads[name] = payload
+    return payloads
+

+def authenticate_authority_roots() -> None:

+def page_words(page: fitz.Page) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    words = []
+    for raw in page.get_text("words"):
+        box = fitz.Rect(raw[:4]) * page.rotation_matrix
+        words.append(
+            {
+                "box": box,
+                "text": raw[4],
+                "block": raw[5],
+                "line": raw[6],
+                "word": raw[7],
+            }
+        )
+    return words

+def vertical_table_rules(page: fitz.Page, clip: fitz.Rect) -> list[float]:
+    """Return deterministic display-space x coordinates for table rulings."""
+
+    candidates = []
+    for drawing in page.get_drawings():
+        box = drawing["rect"] * page.rotation_matrix
+        if (
+            box.width <= 2.0
+            and box.height >= 5.0
+            and box.intersects(clip)
+        ):
+            candidates.append(round((box.x0 + box.x1) / 2.0, 3))
+    return sorted(
+        {
+            candidate
+            for candidate in candidates
+            if clip.x0 < candidate < clip.x1
+        }
+    )
+

+def question_clip(page: fitz.Page, qnum: int) -> fitz.Rect | None:
+    """Return a generic question slice in page display coordinates.
+
+    Question-column headings are detected geometrically. A page containing
+    only the next question is rejected; a continuation above the next heading
+    is retained. No paper, year, session, or question ID is consulted.
+    """
+
+    displayed_words = page_words(page)
+    headings = []
+    for word in displayed_words:
+        match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{1,2})(?:\([a-zivx]+\))?", word["text"], re.I)
+        if match and word["box"].x0 < 130:
+            headings.append((word["box"].y0, int(match.group(1)), word["text"]))
+    targets = [y for y, number, _ in headings if number == qnum]
+    nexts = [y for y, number, _ in headings if number == qnum + 1]
+    header_words = {
+        name: [
+            word["box"].y0
+            for word in displayed_words
+            if word["text"].casefold() == name
+        ]
+        for name in ("question", "answer", "marks")
+    }
+    question_headers = sorted(
+        y
+        for y in header_words["question"]
+        if all(
+            any(abs(y - other_y) <= 2.0 for other_y in header_words[name])
+            for name in ("answer", "marks")
+        )
+    )
+
+    def preceding_header(y: float) -> float | None:
+        candidates = [
+            header_y
+            for header_y in question_headers
+            if 0.0 <= y - header_y <= 60.0
+        ]
+        return max(candidates) if candidates else None
+
+    if targets:
+        target_start = min(targets)
+        start = preceding_header(target_start)
+        start = max(0.0, (start if start is not None else target_start - 5.0))
+        following = [y for y in nexts if y > start + 10.0]
+        if following:
+            next_start = min(following)
+            next_header = preceding_header(next_start)
+            end = next_header if next_header is not None else next_start - 5.0
+        else:
+            end = page.rect.height
+    elif nexts:
+        next_start = min(nexts)
+        if next_start <= 120.0:
+            return None
+        start, end = 0.0, next_start - 5.0
+    else:
+        start, end = 0.0, page.rect.height
+    if end - start < 20:
+        return None
+    return fitz.Rect(0.0, round(start, 3), page.rect.width, round(end, 3))
+
